scenario_scope: Seven primary sources used to sharpen decisions in the November 20 developmental edit.

cases.decision_rationale: The paper uses duplicate suppression and delivery acknowledgment to show how the application's requirements determine where a correctness check belongs.
required_before_drafting: Review the primary passage and the comparison limits before using the result.
evidence_transition_preconditions: Adoption or stronger capability claims require the appropriate matched comparison and an accepted evidence transition.
promotion_blockers: The argument concerns the placement of correctness functions. A receiving journal supports a durable-commit claim under stated assumptions. It leaves delivery and consumption open when those occur at a later boundary.
non_claims: Worked examples are editorial applications. Published results provide contextual evidence.

promotion_blockers: A compensation repairs a specified consequence. It does not erase historical visibility or guarantee compensation succeeds in a different system.

cases.decision_rationale: The mixed-method user study on three datasets measured how teams performed when explanations accompanied AI recommendations.

cases.decision_rationale: Mozannar and Sontag study supervised prediction with a learned decision to predict or refer the case to a downstream expert.

evidence_transition_preconditions: Adoption or stronger capability claims require the appropriate matched comparison and an accepted evidence transition.
promotion_blockers: The formal classification setup assumes a downstream expert whose behavior can be characterized. Practical routing also needs capacity, response time, authority and coverage.
